lines.t: This world has turned to a house of shame,
Hearts unfaithful, calling on His name,
A generation lost in pride,
Reveling in the things He’s denied.
They mingle light with endless night,
Honor with dishonor in their sight,
Praising Him with lips profane,
Breaking His laws again and again.
Repent and turn, the trumpet calls,
For every idol soon shall fall,
The Lord is holy, His Word remains,
For He is the same — He does not change.
Within the churches, deafened ears,
Refuse correction, hold their peers,
Praise with blasphemy intertwined,
Purity lost in the heart of mankind.
He warns the faithful, “Come away,
Stop defiling My holy name,
No pagan feasts, no worldly flame,
Return, My children, be reclaimed.”
Repent and turn, the trumpet calls,
For every idol soon shall fall,
The Lord is holy, His Word remains,
For He is the same — He does not change.
Behold, the day of wrath draws near,
When truth divides the false from clear,
The righteous saved by His strong hand,
The wicked scattered through the land.
Created once for honor’s flame,
Yet trading glory for fleeting gain,
Still mercy cries, “Come back again,”
Before the storm consumes all men.
Repent and turn, the trumpet calls,
For every idol soon shall fall,
The Lord is holy, His Word remains,
For He is the same — He does not change.
You who walk in pride shall fall,
When judgment comes upon us all,
But those who worship in spirit and truth,
Shall stand in glory, made anew.
